dedupe_keys.name: restwasser datenbank swiss hydropower residual flow database

description: The Restwasser-Datenbank documents the residual (environmental) flow requirements of 252 Swiss hydropower plants with an installed capacity of at least 3 MW: 160 run-of-river, 75 storage, 16 pumped-storage plants and one closed-loop plant, together producing about 31,540 GWh a year, roughly 76% of Swiss hydropower. It holds legal, hydrological and technical attributes per plant and can be joined to the Swiss hydropower statistics (WASTA), with residual-flow reaches, catchments and discharge time series. It was built to give an open basis for weighing hydropower expansion against river ecology, drinking water, irrigation, cooling and treatment plant operation under climate change. It is published by WSL's mountain hydrology group on EnviDat as Excel files, zipped shapefiles and a documentation PDF under CC0 (2025 edition, January 2026). Caveats: coverage is national and limited to plants of 3 MW or more, and requirements follow concession documents that may change on renewal. Simulation uses: abstraction constraints for reservoir and hydropower operation models, capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related record: Swiss dams under federal supervision (data-switzerland-dams-under-federal-supervision).
